articles.title_en: Ghosting the Tax Authority: Fake Firms and Tax Fraud in Ecuador
articles.title_cn: 幽灵税务：厄瓜多尔的虚假企业与逃税
articles.abstract_en: An important but poorly understood form of firm tax evasion arises from “ghost firms”—fake firms that issue fraudulent receipts so that their clients can claim false deductions. We provide a unique window into this global phenomenon using transaction-level tax data from Ecuador. Five percent of firms use ghost invoices annually. Among these firms, ghost transactions comprise 14 percent of purchases. Ghost transactions are prevalent among large firms and firms with high-income owners and exhibit suspicious patterns, such as bunching below financial system thresholds. An innovative enforcement intervention targeting ghost clients rather than ghosts themselves led to substantial tax recovery. (JEL D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14)
articles.abstract_cn: 一种重要但鲜为人知的企业逃税形式源于“幽灵企业”——即开具虚假收据以便客户虚报扣除额的虚假企业。我们利用厄瓜多尔的交易级税务数据，为这一全球现象提供了一个独特的视角。每年有百分之五的企业使用幽灵发票。在这些企业中，幽灵交易占采购额的14%。幽灵交易在大型企业和拥有高收入所有者的企业中普遍存在，并表现出可疑的模式，例如在金融系统门槛以下聚集。一项针对幽灵客户而非幽灵本身的创新执法干预措施带来了可观的税收追回。(JEL D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14)

articles.title_en: Detecting Mother-Father Differences in Spending on Children: A New Approach Using Willingness-to-Pay Elicitation
articles.title_cn: 检测父母在子女支出上的差异：一种使用支付意愿诱导的新方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper tests whether mothers and fathers differ in their spending on daughters relative to sons by comparing their willingness to pay (WTP) for specific goods for their children. This method, which we apply in Uganda, offers more precision than the standard method of examining expenditure effects of mothers’ versus fathers’ income. We find that fathers have a lower WTP for their daughters’ than their sons’ human capital but mothers do not. Altruism plays a role: fathers’ but not mothers’ WTP for goods that simply bring joy to their daughters is lower than their WTP for such goods for sons. (JEL D64, G51, J12, J13, J16, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过比较父母为子女特定商品支付意愿（WTP），检验母亲和父亲在女儿相对于儿子的支出上是否存在差异。我们在乌干达应用了这种方法，它比检验母亲与父亲收入支出效应的标准方法更为精确。我们发现，父亲对女儿人力资本的支付意愿低于对儿子的，但母亲并非如此。利他主义发挥作用：父亲对仅为女儿带来快乐商品的支付意愿低于对儿子的，而母亲则没有。（JEL D64, G51, J12, J13, J16, O12）

articles.abstract_en: The classic herding model examines the asymptotic behavior of agents who observe their predecessors’ actions as well as a private signal from an exogenous information structure. In this paper, we introduce a self-interested sender into the model and study her problem of designing this information structure. If agents cannot observe each other, the model reduces to Bayesian persuasion. However, when agents observe predecessors’ actions, they may learn from them, potentially harming the sender. We identify necessary and sufficient conditions under which the sender can nevertheless obtain the same utility as when the agents are unable to observe each other. (JEL D82, D83, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 经典羊群模型考察了观察前人行动以及来自外生信息结构的私人信号的代理人的渐近行为。在本文中，我们将一个自利的发送者引入模型，并研究她设计这一信息结构的问题。如果代理人无法相互观察，该模型简化为贝叶斯说服。然而，当代理人观察前人的行动时，他们可能从中学习，这可能损害发送者的利益。我们确定了发送者仍然能够获得与代理人无法相互观察时相同效用的必要且充分条件。(JEL D82, D83, D91)

articles.title_en: The Impact of Host Language Proficiency on Migrants’ Employment Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 东道国语言熟练度对移民就业结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the economic gains from proficiency in the host country’s language on migrants’ employment outcomes by exploiting the exogenous placement of refugees to Swiss cantons and a sharp language border dividing German- and French-speaking regions. Using administrative data on African refugees who applied for Swiss asylum between 2008 and 2017, I compare French-speaking refugees assigned to the French-speaking region to French-speaking refugees assigned to the German-speaking region and adjust for common regional differences with outcomes from English-speaking African refugees. The results suggest that language proficiency more than doubles the employment level in the first five years after arrival. (JEL J15, J24, J31, J82, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过利用难民被外生安置到瑞士各州以及分隔德语区和法语区的清晰语言边界，估计了掌握东道国语言对移民就业结果的经济收益。使用关于在2008年至2017年间申请瑞士庇护的非洲难民的管理数据，我将被安置到法语区的法语难民与被安置到德语区的法语难民进行比较，并利用来自英语非洲难民的结果调整常见的区域差异。结果表明，语言熟练度使抵达后前五年的就业水平提高了一倍以上。(JEL J15, J24, J31, J82, R23)

articles.abstract_en: We develop a Ricardian model of trade where countries innovate ideas that diffuse globally. Our key result provides necessary and sufficient conditions for innovation and diffusion to generate max-stable Fréchet productivity, linking generalized extreme value expenditure to knowledge flows. Innovation makes a country technologically distinct, reducing its substitutability with other countries. In contrast, diffusion generates technological similarity, increasing head-to-head competition and substitutability. In an innovation-only model where countries do not share ideas, productivities are independent across countries and expenditure is CES. Consequently, departures from CES reveal diffusion patterns. (JEL F11, O31, O33, O41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个李嘉图贸易模型，其中各国创新出在全球扩散的思想。我们的关键结果为创新和扩散生成最大稳定弗雷歇生产率提供了充分必要条件，将广义极值支出与知识流动联系起来。创新使一个国家在技术上独特，降低了其与其他国家的可替代性。相反，扩散产生技术相似性，增加了正面竞争和可替代性。在一个仅创新模型中，各国不共享思想，生产率在国家间独立，支出为CES形式。因此，偏离CES揭示了扩散模式。(JEL F11, O31, O33, O41)

articles.title_cn: 不诚实行为与公共部门就业
articles.abstract_en: We exploit a natural experiment to study the causal link between dishonest behavior and public employment. When military conscription was mandatory in Argentina, eligibility was determined by both a lottery and a medical examination. To avoid conscription, individuals at risk of being drafted had strong incentives to cheat in their medical examination. These incentives varied with the lottery number. Exploiting this exogenous variation, we first present evidence of cheating in medical examinations. We then show that individuals with a higher probability of having cheated in health checks exhibit a higher propensity to occupy nonmeritocratic public sector jobs later in life. (JEL D91, J45, K42, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项自然实验来研究不诚实行为与公共部门就业之间的因果关系。当阿根廷实行义务兵役制时，资格由抽签和体检共同决定。为了避免服兵役，有被征召风险的人有强烈动机在体检中作弊。这些动机随抽签号码而变化。利用这种外生变异，我们首先提供了体检中作弊的证据。然后我们表明，在健康检查中作弊概率较高的个体，在以后的生活中更倾向于担任非精英选拔的公共部门职位。(JEL D91, J45, K42, O15)

articles.title_en: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Reduces Crime and Violence over Ten Years: Experimental Evidence
articles.title_cn: 认知行为疗法在十年内减少犯罪和暴力：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Several small, short-term, or nonexperimental studies show that cognitive behavioral–informed interventions reduce antisocial behaviors over one to two years, but persistence research is rare. We followed 999 high-risk men in Liberia ten years after randomization into eight weeks of low-cost, nonspecialist-led therapy; $200 cash; both; or neither. A decade later, antisocial behaviors (such as robbery and drug selling) fell 0.2 standard deviations from therapy alone—significantly greater than the one-year impacts. Meanwhile, men who received therapy plus cash were 0.25 standard deviations less antisocial—similar to one-year results. In both cases, impacts were concentrated in men exhibiting highest baseline risk. (JEL D91, K42, O15, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 几项小型、短期或非实验性研究表明，认知行为知情干预在一到两年内减少反社会行为，但持续性研究很少。我们在利比里亚对999名高风险男性进行了随机分组，分为八周低成本、非专业主导的治疗；200美元现金；两者兼有；或两者皆无，并随访十年。十年后，仅接受治疗的反社会行为（如抢劫和贩毒）下降了0.2个标准差——显著大于一年期的影响。同时，接受治疗加现金的男性反社会行为减少了0.25个标准差——与一年期结果相似。在两种情况下，影响集中在基线风险最高的男性中。（JEL D91, K42, O15, O17）

articles.title_en: Hiring Frictions and the Promise of Online Job Portals: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 招聘摩擦与在线求职门户的前景：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: Despite the growing prominence of online job portals, firms remain reluctant to hire outside traditional recruitment networks. We find that experimentally providing firms with a combination of advertising and the ability to verify applicant identity increases portal-based hiring by 68 percent and the likelihood of filling a vacancy by 11 percent. Advertising attracts more skilled applicants, while verification enables the screening of unfamiliar applicants. Portal-based hires are retained beyond the standard assessment period, suggesting that they are well suited to the vacancies. Firms assigned only advertising also attract more skilled applicants, but providing neither advertising nor verification alone increases hiring. (JEL D22, J23, J24, J63, M51, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管在线求职门户日益重要，企业仍不愿在传统招聘网络之外进行招聘。我们发现，实验性地向企业提供广告和验证申请人身份的能力相结合，可使基于门户的招聘增加68%，填补空缺职位的可能性增加11%。广告吸引更多技能娴熟的申请人，而验证则能筛选不熟悉的申请人。基于门户的招聘在标准评估期后仍被保留，表明他们非常适合空缺职位。仅被分配广告的企业也吸引了更多技能娴熟的申请人，但仅提供广告或仅提供验证均不能增加招聘。(JEL D22, J23, J24, J63, M51, O15)

articles.title_en: Mistakes in Future Consumption, High MPCs Now
articles.title_cn: 未来消费中的错误，当前高边际消费倾向
articles.abstract_en: In a canonical intertemporal consumption model, future consumption mistakes (in response to saving changes) lead to higher current marginal propensities to consume (MPCs). These mistakes increase the value of changing current consumption relative to changing saving, as additional saving will not be spent optimally. Various behavioral biases can cause these mistakes, such as inattention, present bias, diagnostic expectations, and near-rationality (epsilon-mistakes). This result helps explain the empirical puzzle of high-liquidity consumers’ high MPCs. In my approach, predictions of sophistication (anticipation of future mistakes) can be derived independently of the underlying biases. (JEL D15, D91, E21)
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个典型的跨期消费模型中，未来消费错误（对储蓄变化的反应）会导致当前更高的边际消费倾向（MPCs）。这些错误增加了改变当前消费相对于改变储蓄的价值，因为额外的储蓄将不会被最优地花费。各种行为偏差可能导致这些错误，如注意力不集中、现时偏差、诊断性预期和近似理性（epsilon-错误）。这一结果有助于解释高流动性消费者高MPCs的经验之谜。在我的方法中，对复杂性的预测（对未来错误的预期）可以独立于潜在的偏差得出。（JEL D15, D91, E21）
